subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Digital Forensics in Fraud Cases
description: Learn Digital Forensics in Fraud Cases in one minute.

hook.text: A fraudster deletes emails and wipes the hard drive. A forensic investigator recovers everything.

buildup.text: Digital forensics recovers deleted files, traces communications, and establishes timelines from electronic evidence.

discovery.text: Metadata in documents reveals who created them, when, and on which computer — even after deletion.

twist.text: Courts require strict chain-of-custody rules. Improperly handled digital evidence can be thrown out entirely.

climax.text: In the digital age, fraud leaves electronic footprints. The trick is knowing where and how to look.

punchline.text: Delete everything. Forensics finds it anyway.

quiz.question: What can document metadata reveal in a fraud investigation?
options: Who created a file, when, and on which computer
The current location of the suspect
